name: Work IQ
title: Work IQ | Amplifier Smart Tools
promise: Start with the context that matters.
description: Turn Microsoft 365 work context into a useful briefing. Prepare for your day, walk into meetings informed, and make repeatable workflows from the questions you ask most.
alt: Illustration of calendar and messages coming together as a focused work briefing.
caption: Calendar, conversations, and work context brought together. Process illustration.
flow_title: From scattered context to a clear next step.
flow_intro: Connect through the official Microsoft Work IQ client, then let your agent bring the relevant work into focus.
steps: Use the official Work IQ sign-in flow to access the Microsoft 365 context available to you.
Prepare a daily briefing, gather context for a meeting, or ask a focused question about your work.
Save a domain-specific workflow with named inputs, or build a reviewable data plan for the information you need.
details: Choose a fast calendar-and-email context bundle or a comprehensive, synthesized briefing to prioritize your day.
Gather relevant background for a specific meeting so your preparation starts with the work already happening.
Package project reviews and recurring questions as reusable profiles. Discover resource paths and inspect schemas for precise data plans.
prompt: Use the Work IQ Smart Tool to prepare my Microsoft 365 daily briefing. Read workiq-smart-tool --help and its setup guide. Help me complete the official sign-in setup, then bring together my calendar and relevant work context.
install:
uv tool install git+https://github.com/dacs30/amplifier-smart-tool-workiq
workiq-smart-tool --help
workiq-smart-tool doctor --local-only
prerequisites: Python 3.11+, uv, and Node.js 18+ with npx. Your Microsoft 365 tenant must enable Work IQ and grant its application consent.
model_note: Work IQ uses your signed-in Microsoft 365 account and its existing permissions. The setup guide covers Microsoft's terms and the official sign-in flow.
